blocks.content: Balancing a tree guarantees two primary benefits:

items: Predictable Performance: With a balanced tree, our operations run at a consistent and fast speed.
Space-Efficient: We don't waste memory due to excessive depth.

blocks.content: This means that basic operations on our balanced tree take a predictable amount of time, usually denoted as O(logn), where n is the number of nodes.
Now, let's discuss the common types of structural imbalances that occur in trees.
